summary.primary_gap: Usage is recorded only after a provider response exposes or permits token estimation; attempts that time out or fail before usage recording are absent from llm_calls_count.

counting_definitions.physical_provider_attempt: One actual transport invocation, including success, timeout, rate limit, circuit-open fast failure, malformed response, and SDK/CLI failure.
counting_definitions.logical_llm_request: One caller intent to obtain a typed result; it may contain multiple physical attempts because of transport or parse repair.
counting_definitions.think_run: One invocation of think() identified by run_id; it may contain transaction retries, region reruns, logical LLM requests, and physical attempts.
counting_definitions.stage_interval: One measured interval with explicit parent, start/end, and exclusive/inclusive semantics.
counting_definitions.batch_wall: Monotonic wall from batch release through its declared causal barrier and terminal queue fate.
counting_definitions.run_wall: Monotonic wall from preregistered run start through final drain/barrier and receipt finalization.

surfaces.gap: No attempt id, logical-call id, started/ended time, error class, timeout, retry ordinal, or receipt exists. A failed attempt before _record_usage is invisible.

surfaces.current_source: provider.structured called from the outer Think reasoning retry loop.
surfaces.export: Only aggregate warning logs and successful usage totals.
surfaces.gap: No logical_call_id or durable start/outcome row. Outer transport retries and inner parse retries cannot be reconstructed exactly.

surfaces.current_source: LLMUsageAggregator append on _record_usage, tagged by main_reasoning, question_planning, or parse_repair.
surfaces.export: Think outcome and Prometheus aggregate counters
surfaces.gap: llm_calls_count means recorded usage blocks, not physical attempts or logical requests; Codex CLI/app-server usage can be estimated and cache-token fields remain zero.

surfaces.current_source: ThinkRunRecord plus think_runs progressive transaction row; compact failed row is written out of band.
surfaces.gap: Failed compact rows lose retrieval, LLM latency, stage timing, ops, and retry detail. started_at is rewritten to failure-record time, so failed-run DB wall is not the invocation wall.

surfaces.current_source: Outer reasoning transport attempts, provider parse attempts, Think region reruns, transaction retries, and queue attempts are separate counters.
surfaces.durable_store: think_run_costs.retry_count combines only transaction retries plus region reruns; trigger queue has attempts.
surfaces.export: Partial logs and benchmark queue snapshots
surfaces.gap: retry_count excludes provider transport/parse attempts and conflates transaction retries with region reruns. There is no unified budget or attempt tree.

surfaces.current_source: Per-response usage or text estimate, aggregated by purpose and priced using current model tables.
surfaces.export: Prometheus aggregates and benchmark cost profile
surfaces.gap: Failed attempts may consume provider tokens/cost without a usage record; aggregate rows have no physical attempt lineage.

surfaces.current_source: perf_counter intervals appended to think_stage_timings and stored inside successful think_runs.ops_applied.
surfaces.gap: Intervals have no timestamps or parent ids, are summed as if exclusive, may nest measured_llm_ms inside a wider interval, and are absent from compact failure rows.

surfaces.current_source: think_trigger_queue and downstream queue status/attempt columns plus in-memory depth gauges.
surfaces.export: Worker metrics and benchmark point-in-time queue_counts
surfaces.gap: No single receipt proves enqueue-to-terminal fate across every truth-critical and post-commit queue; point snapshots cannot establish causal closure.

surfaces.current_source: Benchmark-local monotonic elapsed fields and queue snapshots.
surfaces.gap: No core batch identity or durable release/barrier/terminal timestamps; elapsed fields vary by helper and do not reconcile to stage or run walls.

surfaces.current_source: Benchmark-local elapsed_seconds and assembled report artifacts.
surfaces.gap: No one receipt binds commit, config, manifests, provider attempts, batches, queues, costs, and report to a single run; mixed or incomplete evidence cannot be mechanically rejected.

reconciliation_failures.reason: stage intervals are not declared exclusive and failed runs lack them

reconciliation_failures.equation: sum(batch_wall_ms plus declared interbatch gaps) approximately equals run_wall_ms
reconciliation_failures.reason: batch and run receipts are harness-local and lack a common interval contract

reconciliation_failures.equation: all truth-critical queue items have exactly one terminal receipt before the next causal barrier
reconciliation_failures.reason: queues are queried separately and no causal-barrier receipt exists

required_p1_contract.timing_rule: Every interval declares inclusive or exclusive semantics; HG-13 compares independently measured walls with <=1% error.
required_p1_contract.failure_rule: An attempt receipt is written even when no provider usage block is returned.
required_p1_contract.queue_rule: Every eligible queue item links enqueue, lease, retry, terminal fate, and causal barrier.
required_p1_contract.coherence_rule: One final receipt binds commit/config/manifest digests and rejects foreign-run evidence.

completion_rule: P0-D is complete when all current sources and gaps are independently reproduced. HG-13 remains failed until P1 makes TG-001 through TG-005 mechanically computable and exact within the declared tolerance.
